basedOn: R32 independently observed defects and the frozen semantic inventory

changes.change: Ordinary Lark and DingTalk recording catalog entries reach their separate connection/authorization/context-acknowledgement flows. Historical recording routes resolve to the same canonical workflows.
Google Calendar status reflects saved scope and completed archive results. A sync clears outdated pre-sync notices. New connections have a named source-context handoff before intake.
Each MCP import attempt reports its own imported and duplicate counts; importing the same resource again shows zero new records and one duplicate.
Pausing Mac capture replaces the old started notice. Native receipt filters observe both ends of the selected period, and receipt details return to the exact source record.

changes.finding: Inventory native file selection and navigation
changes.change: Native one-time selected-file import is separate from directory collection. Unsaved native settings offer save/continue/discard, and permission/settings returns preserve the original task. Empty-account folder setup initializes safely.

changes.finding: Inventory calendar review and todo semantics
changes.change: Todos preserve optional due dates and complete/cancel/reopen independently. Calendar discovery, edit, fixed review and execution receipts are separate task pages. Fixed review binds evidence/version/target; stale evidence blocks approval, and uncertain execution verifies the existing event instead of creating another.

Central portable archives validate original deployment/account and retain same-operation retry. Future-write encryption, cancellable decryption, administrator retention, index maintenance, scoped statistics and retained diagnostics have focused task pages.

changes.finding: Screen focus and obsolete guide wording
changes.change: Mobile Library no longer repeats its app-bar title in the content heading. Central account/deployment guide entries reflect password/account and saved/effective settings. Unknown trace inspection does not fabricate a retained trace.

authorVerification.root: All three platforms completed calendar fixed-review/stale-evidence/uncertain-result/todo journeys and source catalog/recording/Google/MCP focused checks. The final import regression includes the repaired Mac empty-account folder entry.
authorVerification.native: 46 initial native assertions plus targeted empty-account folder and saved-file-retention checks; handoff and evidence under work/native-r33-*.
authorVerification.central: 11 focused author checks, including nine lifecycle/scope journeys and shared storage/narrow-layout checks on Mac and Android; final source matches its author manifest.
authorVerification.limits: These are author checks of HTML and synthetic fixtures. Independent acceptance is recorded separately after the immutable candidate freeze.

boundary: No backend, native runtime, model, OAuth, real calendar execution, real archive or actual device permission validated.
